provenance_improvement.interpretation: Stronger protocol documentation than the abbreviated current launch page. Values match the existing separate phonon-2-launch-english observation. Does not establish a second corpus family, and does not by itself verify equivalence to the October cleaned-reference core protocol. Preserve existing separation pending exact dataset/protocol verification.

ranking_implication: Phonon-2 and all four Niagara variants have one matched core family. Phonon-1 has separate author-protocol English evidence. Additional English results, English FLEURS runtime conversions, noise tests and overlapping earnings corpora cannot manufacture another independent core vote. Keep missing CORAAL/FLEURS values missing; no aggregate eligibility change is supported by this search.
